ai.description: Roman hippodrome built from project/assets/track_spec.json: racing surface, rails, tiered cavea, arched arcade, statued attic colonnade, raked vomitoria, velarium masts, banners, spina with obelisk/metae/dolphins, towers and torches; stone surfaced with one shared seamless tiling PBR set

budget_note: 30k triangles is the whole venue as ONE object: 44 arcade bays, 44 attic columns, 18 vomitoria, 30 velarium masts, 24 banners, the spina with obelisk, metae and dolphins, 4 towers and 16 torches. The previous 16k was set when this was a bare oval with no Roman elevation on it. Note that gameready.budget still reports OVER here because it models a per-PROP ceiling, and a merged venue is a scene rather than a prop.
